findings: 6 of18 full-core independent samples span Jauch, RRC and Inspired Energy, with both smart hardpack and flatpack references.
Every sampled brand/exact model, chemical class, nominal voltage, cell/pack and rechargeable classification, capacity kind and suggested editable name agrees with its selected source.
Inequality thresholds are retained in original stated labels and explanatory notes/test conditions. They are not physical measurement results.
Numeric S/P is supported only by explicit definitions; nominal voltage or model suffix alone is not used to calculate a configuration.
limitations: Source versions are the actual retrieved editions, not a globally latest-document assertion.
Jauch capacity-test voltage is retained literally; this review does not interpret it as an operating pack cutoff or charger setting.
Source statements do not establish school stock, compatibility approval or the identity of a received battery.
No underlying cell factory is inferred from a pack-brand page.
